results.trackName: Falling for the Orchard Owner: A Sweet Small Town Romance
results.description:
He's the grumpy orchard owner who wants to be left alone.
She's the sunshine teacher who refuses to stay away.

Charlie Sutton only planned to spend one quiet autumn in Amberwood Falls.
A fresh start. A temporary escape. Nothing more.

But everything changes the moment she wanders into Ethan Morgan's orchard.

Ethan is guarded, stubborn, and determined to keep his distance—especially from the bright, endlessly curious teacher who seems intent on breaking down his walls.

Charlie knows she should keep things professional.
Ethan knows he should keep his heart off-limits.

But between apple-picking season, small-town charm, and one very determined golden retriever, staying away from each other becomes impossible.

She's only passing through.
He's rooted in the past.

But sometimes love grows where you least expect it…

A sweet small-town romance filled with cozy autumn charm, grumpy x sunshine chemistry, and a guaranteed happily ever after. Perfect for fans of The Pumpkin Spice Café.
